1. (Currently amended) A cosmetic composition comprising an indole compound of formula I:

[formula I structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9 and R10 are each independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, aryloxy, acyl, acyloxy, nitro, amino, alkylamino, dialkylamino, cyano, alkoxycarbonyl, carboxyl, carboxamide, alkylsulfonyl, arylsulfonyl, alkylsulfonylamino, arylsulfonylamino, and trifluoromethyl groups, and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __for improving skin appearance by reducing visible signs of aging__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 1 or 3, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

6. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, __in an amount of 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight__.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for improving skin appearance by reducing visible signs of aging__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, specifically ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and specifically all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums__.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __by topical application__.

11. (Previously presented) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __by topical application__.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin __by topical application__.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the reduction of time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __specifically for reduction of dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin by topical application__.
